name: Ahtesham Web Vitals Booster
author: ahteshamjamil

sections.description:
Ahtesham Web Vitals Booster is designed from the ground up for speed, rock-solid stability, and zero-breakage risk. It boosts your Google PageSpeed and GTmetrix scores by applying modern web performance techniques safely.

Unlike aggressive cache plugins that break dynamic sites, page builders, and ecommerce checkout flows, Ahtesham Web Vitals Booster is built with safe defaults, automated WooCommerce & Elementor protections, and an instant rollback snapshot engine.

Key Features:

  • Delay Non-Critical JavaScript: Delays heavy third-party scripts (Google Analytics, tracking tags, chat widgets, heavy theme scripts) until first user interaction (scroll, click, touch, keydown) for dramatically improved INP and TBT scores.
  • Smart Lazy Loading (LCP Safe): Automatically lazy-loads offscreen images while intelligently excluding hero/above-the-fold images to keep your Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) blazing fast.
  • Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) Fixes: Automatically detects and injects missing width and height attributes on images to prevent jarring layout shifts.
  • Font Display Optimization: Appends display=swap to font requests to eliminate render-blocking font flashes.
  • WordPress Bloat Removal: One-click disable for WP Emojis, oEmbed scripts, query strings (?ver=), and Heartbeat API control.
  • Browser Caching: Adds high-performance cache-control headers for static resources.
  • Diagnostics & Conflict Detection: Scans server environment and detects duplicate cache engines.
  • WooCommerce & Elementor Safe: Auto-protects cart, checkout, customer sessions, and builder preview modes.
  • Snapshots & Rollback: 1-click restore to any previous settings backup and emergency safe mode URL parameter.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ahtesham-web-vitals-booster folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Web Vitals Booster in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select a 1-click preset (Safe Mode or Balanced Mode) or customize your settings.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin break my WooCommerce store?

No! Ahtesham Web Vitals Booster includes dedicated WooCommerce integration that automatically excludes Cart, Checkout, and My Account endpoints from aggressive script optimizations.

What if a setting causes an issue with my theme?

You can easily restore previous settings with 1 click using the built-in Settings Snapshot engine, or access your site with ?awvb_safe_mode=1 in the URL to temporarily bypass optimizations.
